name: Tajny Sadovogo Tovarischestva
source:
The story is about a weekend trip to the house of the protagonist's deceased uncle where he once stayed as a child and which his uncle left to him as an inheritance.

[Translated from [url=https://anivisual.net/stuff/2-1-0-176]Anivisual[/url]]
translation:
故事讲述了主人公在周末前往已故叔叔留给他的房子——一个他小时候曾住过的地方。

[翻译自[url=https://anivisual.net/stuff/2-1-0-176]Anivisual[/url]]
